comparison.rationale: Blender stores mesh coordinates, corner UVs/colors, and vertex-group weights as float32. The absolute term covers rounding through transformed float mesh coordinates and ray/triangle evaluation; the relative term scales for larger coordinates. Topology is compared exactly.

description: Blender 5.2.2 Shrinkwrap differential oracle; input meshes, object transforms, full modifier parameters, evaluated geometry, corner normals, UV/color attributes, and group weights are stored per case.
